purpose: 162 device and I/O function definitions explained through five shared mechanism diagrams
output_policy: Selected generated PNG files copied byte-for-byte into the repository; all original generated images remain in place.
qa_method: Visual inspection of each generatedImage return against audited source and figure specifications; SHA256 source-copy equality and dimensions checked.

figures.name: console-input
qa_checks: Input sources: PS/2 IRQ1 and COM IRQ4 feed the same event queue
256 event records distinguished from ASCII character count
BKL + CLI check-register-recheck-block protocol; wake does not consume
Insert x at a|bc produces ax|bc
80x25 VGA 16-bit character/color cells and scrolling
Overflow drains to Enter and rejects the whole line; ASCII-only editor

figures.name: interrupt-devices
qa_checks: PCI address/select-data split and 16-bit command writes avoid status W1C
PIC masks: 0 allow, 1 block; slave IRQs route via master IRQ2
Only default100Hz output leads to BSP global tick; independent AP LAPIC has no PIT input arrow
Device acknowledgement explicitly conditional; slave EOI when applicable, then master EOI, then possible stack switch
Formal threads block/sleep, early no-thread path alone uses bare HLT
CLI is CPU-local; bounded polling is not a precise wall-clock timeout

edit_history.reason: Initial generation implied a PIT input branch into both BSP and AP; first local edit separated AP but retained a wrong branch at raw1193182Hz.
Connected only default100Hz output to BSP globaltick and retained AP independent timer.
Changed panel(d) acknowledgement to conditional device status read, because PIT handler does not read-to-clear a device register.

figures.name: storage-io
qa_checks: BlockDevice read/write/flush dispatch has RAM BootVolume and ATA PIO backends
Boot RAM writes copy only RAM and do not persist across restart
Primary-master single-sector LBA28 commands; nIEN disables IDE IRQ
256 16-bit data words make one 512B sector; PIO is CPU copying
FLUSH CACHE 0xE7 is a device durability request, not file-system power-failure atomicity
Reject ATAPI, no-LBA, non512B; maximum2^28 sectors and one-million status polls

figures.name: virtio-dma
qa_checks: Ring uses physically continuous2-3 pages, packet buffers use independent pages
Two descriptors:10B header at offset0, payload at64;54B gap not transmitted
64 descriptors give32frames,256 descriptors capped64frames
Descriptor/data/avail slot before MFENCE/avail index/MFENCE/notify
Used index before LFENCE/content, TX clears in-flight, RX synchronous callback then requeues
BSP single hardware RX queue budget32; AP user UDP uses software inbox
Failure retains possibly DMA-active pages; initialization frees only after confirmed device reset

figures.name: logging-observability
qa_checks: 128B record structure sums exact field widths including reserved4B
256 slots;sequence starts1,slot=(sequence-1)%256
Write257 overwrites1 and retained window becomes2..257
Incremental reads copy retained records in sequence order within capacity; overwritten history unrecoverable
Writer fixed-size, no allocation, no blocking and no serial printing; CLI plus caller-owned BKL
Performance ABIv1 is128B,rawTSC not calibrated nanoseconds,onlineCPUcount not speedup
Freestanding memory routines bytewise O(N); memcpy requires no overlap; memmove handles direction
Payload capacity is explicitly15/87 bytes plus NUL, not15/87 Unicode characters
